(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-MODULE 2.1: 2oo3 TMR Contactor Chamber Absolute Pressure Voting Logic
   Evaluates cross-channel deviations between Sensor A, Sensor B, and Sensor C.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rPressDiscrepancy_AB := ABS(rPress_SensorA_kPa - rPress_SensorB_kPa);
rPressDiscrepancy_BC := ABS(rPress_SensorB_kPa - rPress_SensorC_kPa);
rPressDiscrepancy_CA := ABS(rPress_SensorC_kPa - rPress_SensorA_kPa);

(* Debounce cross-channel divergence for 3.0 seconds *)
tPressDiscrepancyTimer(IN := (rPressDiscrepancy_AB > rPressTolerance_kPa) OR
                             (rPressDiscrepancy_BC > rPressTolerance_kPa) OR
                             (rPressDiscrepancy_CA > rPressTolerance_kPa),
                       PT := T#3.0S);

(* Outlier identification and sensor health attribution *)
bPressA_Healthy := NOT ((rPressDiscrepancy_AB > rPressTolerance_kPa) AND (rPressDiscrepancy_CA > rPressTolerance_kPa));
bPressB_Healthy := NOT ((rPressDiscrepancy_AB > rPressTolerance_kPa) AND (rPressDiscrepancy_BC > rPressTolerance_kPa));
bPressC_Healthy := NOT ((rPressDiscrepancy_BC > rPressTolerance_kPa) AND (rPressDiscrepancy_CA > rPressTolerance_kPa));

(* Count operational pressure transmitters *)
iPressHealthyCount := 0;
IF bPressA_Healthy THEN iPressHealthyCount := iPressHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPressB_Healthy THEN iPressHealthyCount := iPressHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPressC_Healthy THEN iPressHealthyCount := iPressHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Consensus Voting Algorithm: Mid-value selection for 3 healthy, average for 2, fallback for 1 *)
IF iPressHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rPress_SensorA_kPa >= rPress_SensorB_kPa) AND (rPress_SensorA_kPa <= rPress_SensorC_kPa)) OR
       ((rPress_SensorA_kPa <= rPress_SensorB_kPa) AND (rPress_SensorA_kPa >= rPress_SensorC_kPa)) THEN
        rVotedContactorPressure_kPa := rPress_SensorA_kPa;
    ELSIF ((rPress_SensorB_kPa >= rPress_SensorA_kPa) AND (rPress_SensorB_kPa <= rPress_SensorC_kPa)) OR
          ((rPress_SensorB_kPa <= rPress_SensorA_kPa) AND (rPress_SensorB_kPa >= rPress_SensorC_kPa)) THEN
        rVotedContactorPressure_kPa := rPress_SensorB_kPa;
    ELSE
        rVotedContactorPressure_kPa := rPress_SensorC_kPa;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPressHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* 1oo2 Fail-Operational Degraded Mode: Average remaining 2 healthy channels *)
    IF bPressA_Healthy AND bPressB_Healthy THEN
        rVotedContactorPressure_kPa := (rPress_SensorA_kPa + rPress_SensorB_kPa) * 0.50;
    ELSIF bPressB_Healthy AND bPressC_Healthy THEN
        rVotedContactorPressure_kPa := (rPress_SensorB_kPa + rPress_SensorC_kPa) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rVotedContactorPressure_kPa := (rPress_SensorA_kPa + rPress_SensorC_kPa) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000001; (* Warning Bit 0: Pressure sensor redundancy degraded *)
ELSIF iPressHealthyCount = 1 THEN
    (* Severe degradation: Single surviving channel *)
    IF bPressA_Healthy THEN rVotedContactorPressure_kPa := rPress_SensorA_kPa;
    ELSIF bPressB_Healthy THEN rVotedContactorPressure_kPa := rPress_SensorB_kPa;
    ELSE rVotedContactorPressure_kPa := rPress_SensorC_kPa;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000002; (* Warning Bit 1: Pressure 1oo1 critical degradation *)
ELSE
    (* Total 2oo3 voting collapse: Trigger critical alarm and safe park *)
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000001; (* Alarm Bit 0: All pressure sensors failed *)
    rVotedContactorPressure_kPa := rContactorPressure_kPa;   (* Fallback to direct input *)
    iState := 999;

    ELSIF ((rO2_SensorB_pct >= rO2_SensorA_pct) AND (rO2_SensorB_pct <= rO2_SensorC_pct)) OR
          ((rO2_SensorB_pct <= rO2_SensorA_pct) AND (rO2_SensorB_pct >= rO2_SensorC_pct)) THEN
        rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorB_pct;
    ELSE
        rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorC_pct;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iO2HealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Conservative safety bias: Select MAX of surviving 2 sensors to prevent un-detected O2 ingress *)
    IF bO2_A_Healthy AND bO2_B_Healthy THEN
        IF rO2_SensorA_pct > rO2_SensorB_pct THEN rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorA_pct; ELSE rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorB_pct; END_IF;
    ELSIF bO2_B_Healthy AND bO2_C_Healthy THEN
        IF rO2_SensorB_pct > rO2_SensorC_pct THEN rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorB_pct; ELSE rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorC_pct; END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF rO2_SensorA_pct > rO2_SensorC_pct THEN rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorA_pct; ELSE rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorC_pct; END_IF;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000010; (* Warning Bit 4: O2 Analyzer redundancy degraded *)
ELSIF iO2HealthyCount = 1 THEN
    IF bO2_A_Healthy THEN rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorA_pct;
    ELSIF bO2_B_Healthy THEN rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorB_pct;
    ELSE rVotedO2_pct := rO2_SensorC_pct;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000020; (* Warning Bit 5: O2 Analyzer 1oo1 mode *)
ELSE
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000004; (* Alarm Bit 2: All O2 analyzers failed *)
    rVotedO2_pct := rOxygenConcentration_pct;
    iState := 999;
END_IF;

(* Flammability & Thermal Oxidation Barrier Interlock Flag *)
bInertBarrierEstablished := (rVotedO2_pct <= rMaxAllowableO2_pct) AND (iO2HealthyCount >= 1);
bDegradedSensorMode := (iPressHealthyCount < 3) OR (iTempHealthyCount < 3) OR (iO2HealthyCount < 3);
(*
====================================================================================================
  MODULE 3: DUAL-SITE LANGMUIR-TOTH ISOTHERM & CONDENSATE MASS/ENERGY BALANCING
====================================================================================================
*)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-MODULE 3.1: In-Situ Amine Sorbent Chemisorption Thermodynamics
   Langmuir affinity parameter: b(T) = b0 * exp(-DeltaH_ads / (R * T))
   At 25 deg C: T = 298.15 K, b ~ 1.45e-5 * exp(68500 / (8.314 * 298.15)) ~ 1.46e7 [1/bar] = 146.0 [1/kPa]
   Dual-site Langmuir-Toth Loading Equation:
     q* = q_max * (b * P_CO2) / (1 + (b * P_CO2)^t)^(1/t)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTempCalc := rVotedBedTemp_degC + rZeroKelvin_degC;
IF rTempCalc < 273.15 THEN rTempCalc := 273.15; END_IF;

(* CO2 Partial Pressure in Pascals *)
IF iState = 10 THEN
    (* Adsorption Phase: based on ambient CO2 concentration [ppm] and atmospheric pressure *)
    rCO2PartialPressure_Pa := (rAmbientCO2_ppm * 1.0E-6) * (rVotedContactorPressure_kPa * 1000.0);
ELSE
    (* Desorption / Vacuum Phase: based on desorbed CO2 purity fraction and vacuum pressure *)
    rCO2PartialPressure_Pa := (rDesorbedCO2Purity_pct * 0.010) * (rVotedContactorPressure_kPa * 1000.0);
END_IF;

IF rCO2PartialPressure_Pa < 0.010 THEN rCO2PartialPressure_Pa := 0.010; END_IF;

(* Temperature-dependent affinity calculation via Arrhenius relation *)
rTempCalc := (rDeltaH_Adsorption_kJmol * -1000.0) / (rGasConstant_R * rTempCalc);
IF rTempCalc > 35.0 THEN rTempCalc := 35.0; END_IF; (* Bound exponential to prevent math overflow *)
IF rTempCalc < -10.0 THEN rTempCalc := -10.0; END_IF;

(* Calculated affinity b in [1/Pa] *)
rLogMeanNum := rLangmuir_b0 * EXP(rTempCalc);

(* Dimensionless pressure-affinity product *)
rLogMeanDen := rLogMeanNum * rCO2PartialPressure_Pa;

(* Toth Isotherm calculation: q* = q_max * X / (1 + X^t)^(1/t) *)
IF rLogMeanDen > 0.000010 THEN
    rTempCalc := EXPT(rLogMeanDen, rToth_HeterogeneityParam);
    rTempCalc := EXPT(1.0 + rTempCalc, (1.0 / rToth_HeterogeneityParam));
    rEquilibriumLoading_qStar := rMaxSorbentCapacity_molkg * (rLogMeanDen / rTempCalc);
ELSE
    rEquilibriumLoading_qStar := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Mass transfer driving force and instantaneous molar flux [mol/(kg*s)] *)
rAdsorptionDrivingForce := rEquilibriumLoading_qStar - rCurrentSorbentLoading_q;

IF iState = 10 THEN
    (* Adsorption uptake: Linear driving force (LDF) model k_ads = 0.0085 s^-1 *)
    rInstantaneousCO2Flux_molks := 0.0085 * rAdsorptionDrivingForce;
    rCurrentSorbentLoading_q := rCurrentSorbentLoading_q + (rInstantaneousCO2Flux_molks * 0.100); (* Integrate at Ts=0.1s *)
    IF rCurrentSorbentLoading_q > rMaxSorbentCapacity_molkg THEN
        rCurrentSorbentLoading_q := rMaxSorbentCapacity_molkg;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (iState = 60) OR (iState = 70) THEN
    (* Thermal steam stripping desorption flux: accelerated kinetics at 100 deg C *)
    rInstantaneousCO2Flux_molks := 0.0350 * rAdsorptionDrivingForce; (* Note driving force is negative during desorption *)
    rCurrentSorbentLoading_q := rCurrentSorbentLoading_q + (rInstantaneousCO2Flux_molks * 0.100);
    IF rCurrentSorbentLoading_q < 0.150 THEN
        rCurrentSorbentLoading_q := 0.150; (* Residual un-desorbed loading limit *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Mass of CO2 liberated/extracted rate [kg/h] *)
rExtractedCO2Rate_kgh := ABS(rInstantaneousCO2Flux_molks) * rSorbentDryMass_kg * (rMW_CO2 / 1000.0) * 3600.0;

(* Desorbed CO2 Product Volumetric Purity Estimation *)
IF (iState = 70) AND (rCO2ProductFlow_Nm3h > 10.0) THEN
    (* High-purity regime: water vapor condensed downstream, residual non-condensables *)
    rDesorbedCO2Purity_pct := 95.0 + (5.0 * (1.0 - (rVotedO2_pct / 0.50)));
    IF rDesorbedCO2Purity_pct > 99.80 THEN rDesorbedCO2Purity_pct := 99.80; END_IF;
    IF rDesorbedCO2Purity_pct < 85.00 THEN rDesorbedCO2Purity_pct := 85.00; END_IF;
ELSE
    rDesorbedCO2Purity_pct := (rAmbientCO2_ppm * 0.00010); (* Baseline ambient 0.042% *)
END_IF;
bCO2PurityCompliant := (rDesorbedCO2Purity_pct >= 95.0) AND (iState = 70);

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-MODULE 3.2: Multi-Stage Roots Vacuum Blower Compression Ratio & Power
   Compression ratio r_p = P_discharge / P_suction.
   For multi-stage booster: P_suction = rVotedContactorPressure_kPa, P_discharge = 101.3 kPa.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rVotedContactorPressure_kPa > 1.0 THEN
    rRootsCompressionRatio := rAmbientPressure_kPa / rVotedContactorPressure_kPa;
ELSE
    rRootsCompressionRatio := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Interlock: Trip Roots blower if single stage compression ratio exceeds 2.65 or temp > 135 deg C *)
IF (rRootsDischargeTemp_degC > 135.0) OR (rRootsCompressionRatio > 8.5) THEN
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000008; (* Alarm Bit 3: Roots Blower Thermal / Compression Overload *)
    IF (iState = 40) OR (iState = 50) OR (iState = 70) THEN
        iState := 999;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-MODULE 3.3: Economizer Latent Heat Recovery & Condensate Flash Vessel Balancer
   Computes Logarithmic Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) and recovered duty:
     DeltaT1 = T_steam_in - T_cooling_water_out
     DeltaT2 = T_cond_out - T_cooling_water_in
     LMTD = (DeltaT1 - DeltaT2) / ln(DeltaT1 / DeltaT2)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rLogMeanNum := (rSteamSupplyTemp_degC - 45.0) - (rEconomizerExhaustTemp_degC - 20.0);
rLogMeanDen := (rSteamSupplyTemp_degC - 45.0) / (rEconomizerExhaustTemp_degC - 20.0 + 0.001);
IF rLogMeanDen < 1.001 THEN rLogMeanDen := 1.001; END_IF;
rEconomizerLMTD_degC := rLogMeanNum / LN(rLogMeanDen);
IF rEconomizerLMTD_degC < 1.0 THEN rEconomizerLMTD_degC := 1.0; END_IF;

(* Instantaneous Latent Heat Recovery Duty [kW] *)
rEconomizerHeatDuty_kW := rOverallEconomizerUA_kWK * rEconomizerLMTD_degC;
rEconomizerThermalRecovery_kW := rEconomizerHeatDuty_kW;

(* Closed-loop Condensate Mass Balancing: Accumulation = Steam_in - Drain_out *)
rCondensateMassImbalance_kgh := rSteamMassFlow_kgh - rCondensateDrainFlow_kgh;
rCondensateBalanceRate_kgh := rCondensateMassImbalance_kgh;

(* Specific Desorption Energy Consumption [MJ / kg CO2 captured] *)
IF rExtractedCO2Rate_kgh > 5.0 THEN
    (* Thermal energy supplied via steam: Q_steam = m_steam * (h_steam - h_condensate) *)
    rTempCalc := (rSteamMassFlow_kgh * (rSteamSpecificEnthalpy_kJkg - rCondensateEnthalpy_kJkg)) / 1000.0; (* MJ/h *)
    rSpecificDesorptionEnergy_MJkgCO2 := rTempCalc / rExtractedCO2Rate_kgh;
ELSE
    rSpecificDesorptionEnergy_MJkgCO2 := 0.0;
END_IF;
(*
====================================================================================================
  MODULE 4: KALMAN FILTER OBSERVER & CONSTRAINED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Populate Process Measurement Vector y[k] *)
vecMeas_y[1] := rVotedBedTemp_degC;
vecMeas_y[2] := rVotedContactorPressure_kPa;
vecMeas_y[3] := rDesorbedCO2Purity_pct;
vecMeas_y[4] := rEconomizerFlashLevel_pct;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-MODULE 4.1: Steady-State Discrete Kalman Filter Observer
   Innovation: e[k] = y[k] - C_d * x_pred[k]
   Measurement Update: x_hat[k|k] = x_pred[k] + K * e[k]
   Time Update: x_pred[k+1] = A_d * x_hat[k|k] + B_d * u[k]
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    rSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rSum := rSum + (matC[iIdx, jIdx] * vecState_x_pred[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    vecResidual_y[iIdx] := vecMeas_y[iIdx] - rSum;
END_FOR;

(* State Update with Kalman Gain Matrix *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    rSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        rSum := rSum + (matK_Kalman[iIdx, jIdx] * vecResidual_y[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x[iIdx] := vecState_x_pred[iIdx] + rSum;
END_FOR;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-MODULE 4.2: Constrained Model Predictive Control Optimizer
   Solves quadratic objective function via iterative Projected Gradient Descent:
     min J(u) = 1/2 * (x - x_sp)^T * Q * (x - x_sp) + 1/2 * delta_u^T * R * delta_u
     Gradient: nabla_J = B_d^T * Q * (x - x_sp) + R * delta_u
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bAutoMPC_Mode AND (iState = 70) AND (NOT bDegradedSensorMode) THEN
    (* Define Desorption Phase Targets *)
    vecTarget_x[1] := rTargetDesorptionTemp_degC;   (* 100.0 deg C *)
    vecTarget_x[2] := rTargetDesorptionPress_kPa;  (* 20.0 kPa *)
    vecTarget_x[3] := 98.0;                         (* Target 98% CO2 purity *)
    vecTarget_x[4] := 0.20;                         (* Target residual loading 0.20 mol/kg *)
    vecTarget_x[5] := rTargetFlashTankLevel_pct;    (* 50.0% flash tank level *)

    (* Compute Quadratic Cost Gradient nabla_J *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rSum := 0.0;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
            (* B_d^T * Q * (x - x_sp) *)
            rSum := rSum + (matB[jIdx, iIdx] * vecWeight_Q[jIdx] * (vecState_x[jIdx] - vecTarget_x[jIdx]));
        END_FOR;
        (* Add Actuator Rate Penalty R * delta_u *)
        vecGradient_g[iIdx] := rSum + (vecWeight_R[iIdx] * vecDeltaU[iIdx]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Projected Gradient Descent Iteration with Hard Constraints *)
    FOR kIdx := 1 TO iMpcMaxIterations DO
        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
            (* Step along negative gradient *)
            vecDeltaU[iIdx] := vecDeltaU[iIdx] - (rMpcStepSize * vecGradient_g[iIdx]);
        END_FOR;

        (* Clamp Slew Rates *)
        IF vecDeltaU[1] > rMaxDeltaU1_SteamValve THEN vecDeltaU[1] := rMaxDeltaU1_SteamValve; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaU[1] < -rMaxDeltaU1_SteamValve THEN vecDeltaU[1] := -rMaxDeltaU1_SteamValve; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaU[2] > rMaxDeltaU2_RootsVFD THEN vecDeltaU[2] := rMaxDeltaU2_RootsVFD; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaU[2] < -rMaxDeltaU2_RootsVFD THEN vecDeltaU[2] := -rMaxDeltaU2_RootsVFD; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaU[3] > rMaxDeltaU3_VacThrottle THEN vecDeltaU[3] := rMaxDeltaU3_VacThrottle; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaU[3] < -rMaxDeltaU3_VacThrottle THEN vecDeltaU[3] := -rMaxDeltaU3_VacThrottle; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaU[4] > rMaxDeltaU4_N2Purge THEN vecDeltaU[4] := rMaxDeltaU4_N2Purge; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaU[4] < -rMaxDeltaU4_N2Purge THEN vecDeltaU[4] := -rMaxDeltaU4_N2Purge; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaU[5] > rMaxDeltaU5_CoolingValve THEN vecDeltaU[5] := rMaxDeltaU5_CoolingValve; END_IF;
        IF vecDeltaU[5] < -rMaxDeltaU5_CoolingValve THEN vecDeltaU[5] := -rMaxDeltaU5_CoolingValve; END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Update Control Inputs: u[k] = u[k-1] + delta_u *)
    vecInput_u[1] := vecInput_u_prev[1] + vecDeltaU[1];
    vecInput_u[2] := vecInput_u_prev[2] + vecDeltaU[2];
    vecInput_u[3] := vecInput_u_prev[3] + vecDeltaU[3];
    vecInput_u[4] := 0.0; (* N2 purge strictly closed during active steam desorption *)
    vecInput_u[5] := vecInput_u_prev[5] + vecDeltaU[5];

    (* Enforce Hard Actuator Physical Saturation Bounds *)
    IF vecInput_u[1] > rMaxSteamValve_pct THEN vecInput_u[1] := rMaxSteamValve_pct; END_IF;
    IF vecInput_u[1] < rMinSteamValve_pct THEN vecInput_u[1] := rMinSteamValve_pct; END_IF;
    IF vecInput_u[2] > rMaxRootsVFD_pct THEN vecInput_u[2] := rMaxRootsVFD_pct; END_IF;
    IF vecInput_u[2] < rMinRootsVFD_pct THEN vecInput_u[2] := rMinRootsVFD_pct; END_IF;
    IF vecInput_u[3] > rMaxVacThrottle_pct THEN vecInput_u[3] := rMaxVacThrottle_pct; END_IF;
    IF vecInput_u[3] < rMinVacThrottle_pct THEN vecInput_u[3] := rMinVacThrottle_pct; END_IF;
    IF vecInput_u[5] > rMaxCoolingValve_pct THEN vecInput_u[5] := rMaxCoolingValve_pct; END_IF;
    IF vecInput_u[5] < rMinCoolingValve_pct THEN vecInput_u[5] := rMinCoolingValve_pct; END_IF;

ELSE
    (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       SUB-MODULE 4.3: Graceful Degradation Decoupled PID Regulators Fallback
       Active when MPC is disabled, in manual fallback, or under sensor redundancy degradation.
       --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* Temperature Loop: LP Steam Control Valve *)
    IF (iState = 60) OR (iState = 70) THEN
        rPidTemp_Error := rTargetDesorptionTemp_degC - rVotedBedTemp_degC;
        rPidTemp_Integral := rPidTemp_Integral + (rPidTemp_Error * 0.100);
        IF rPidTemp_Integral > 100.0 THEN rPidTemp_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
        IF rPidTemp_Integral < -50.0 THEN rPidTemp_Integral := -50.0; END_IF;

        vecInput_u[1] := (rPidTemp_Kp * rPidTemp_Error) +
                         ((rPidTemp_Kp / rPidTemp_Ti) * rPidTemp_Integral) +
                         (rPidTemp_Kp * rPidTemp_Td * (rPidTemp_Error - rPidTemp_PrevError) * 10.0);
        rPidTemp_PrevError := rPidTemp_Error;
    ELSE
        vecInput_u[1] := 0.0;
        rPidTemp_Integral := 0.0;
        rPidTemp_PrevError := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Vacuum Pressure Loop: Roots Booster Blower VFD Speed *)
    IF (iState = 50) OR (iState = 70) OR (iState = 90) THEN
        rPidPress_Error := rTargetDesorptionPress_kPa - rVotedContactorPressure_kPa;
        rPidPress_Integral := rPidPress_Integral + (rPidPress_Error * 0.100);
        IF rPidPress_Integral > 100.0 THEN rPidPress_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
        IF rPidPress_Integral < -50.0 THEN rPidPress_Integral := -50.0; END_IF;

        vecInput_u[2] := 60.0 + (rPidPress_Kp * rPidPress_Error) +
                         ((rPidPress_Kp / rPidPress_Ti) * rPidPress_Integral) +
                         (rPidPress_Kp * rPidPress_Td * (rPidPress_Error - rPidPress_PrevError) * 10.0);
        rPidPress_PrevError := rPidPress_Error;
    ELSE
        vecInput_u[2] := 0.0;
        rPidPress_Integral := 0.0;
        rPidPress_PrevError := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Condensate Level Loop: Economizer Flash Tank Drain Valve *)
    rPidLevel_Error := rVotedContactorPressure_kPa; (* Dummy use for syntax *)
    rPidLevel_Error := rEconomizerFlashLevel_pct - rTargetFlashTankLevel_pct;
    rPidLevel_Integral := rPidLevel_Integral + (rPidLevel_Error * 0.100);
    IF rPidLevel_Integral > 100.0 THEN rPidLevel_Integral := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF rPidLevel_Integral < -50.0 THEN rPidLevel_Integral := -50.0; END_IF;

    rCondensateDrainValveDemand_pct := 50.0 + (rPidLevel_Kp * rPidLevel_Error) +
                                      ((rPidLevel_Kp / rPidLevel_Ti) * rPidLevel_Integral) +
                                      (rPidLevel_Kp * rPidLevel_Td * (rPidLevel_Error - rPidLevel_PrevError) * 10.0);
    rPidLevel_PrevError := rPidLevel_Error;
    IF rCondensateDrainValveDemand_pct > 100.0 THEN rCondensateDrainValveDemand_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF rCondensateDrainValveDemand_pct < 0.0 THEN rCondensateDrainValveDemand_pct := 0.0; END_IF;

    (* Cooling Water Valve Base Regulation *)
    IF (iState = 70) OR (iState = 80) THEN
        vecInput_u[5] := 75.0;
    ELSE
        vecInput_u[5] := 15.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Final Clamps on Fallback Actuator Demands *)
    IF vecInput_u[1] > 100.0 THEN vecInput_u[1] := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF vecInput_u[1] < 0.0 THEN vecInput_u[1] := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF vecInput_u[2] > 100.0 THEN vecInput_u[2] := 100.0; END_IF;
    IF vecInput_u[2] < 0.0 THEN vecInput_u[2] := 0.0; END_IF;
    vecInput_u[3] := 100.0; (* Fully open vacuum line during active stages *)
    vecInput_u[4] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Forward One-Step State Prediction: x_pred[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    rSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rSum := rSum + (matA[iIdx, jIdx] * vecState_x[jIdx]) + (matB[iIdx, jIdx] * vecInput_u[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    vecState_x_pred[iIdx] := rSum;
    vecInput_u_prev[iIdx] := vecInput_u[iIdx];
END_FOR;
(*
====================================================================================================
  MODULE 5: 14-STAGE DETERMINISTIC SEQUENCE STATE MACHINE
====================================================================================================
*)
(* State Duration Stopwatch Timer *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#24H);
IF iState <> iPrevState THEN
    rStateElapsedSec := 0.0;
    iPrevState := iState;
ELSE
    rStateElapsedSec := TIME_TO_REAL(tStateTimer.ET) / 1000.0;
END_IF;

CASE iState OF

    0: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 0: IDLE_STANDBY
          Contactor un-pressurized or at ambient pressure, actuators in de-energized fail-safe mode.
          Verifies all system permissives before initiating an adsorption sequence.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        rAirFanSpeedSP_pct              := 0.0;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 0.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 0.0;
        rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct         := 0.0;
        rEconomizerCoolingValveDemand_pct:= 0.0;
        bAirLouversCommandOpen          := FALSE;
        bSteamSafetyShutoffCommand      := FALSE;
        bDesorptionActive               := FALSE;
        bSystemReady                    := bSafetyRelayOK AND (NOT bEStopLatched) AND (iPressHealthyCount >= 2);

        IF bEnableSystem AND bSystemReady THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to AMBIENT_AIR_ADSORPTION *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 10: AMBIENT_AIR_ADSORPTION (420 ppm CO2 Capture)
          Sealing louvers open, axial fans ramp up to rated intake flow (e.g. 15,000 Nm3/h),
          monolithic amine honeycomb extracts CO2 from ambient air.
          Terminates when sorbent approaches mass transfer zone breakthrough or max cycle duration.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        bAirLouversCommandOpen          := TRUE;
        bSteamSafetyShutoffCommand      := FALSE;
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 0.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 0.0;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct         := 0.0;
        bDesorptionActive               := FALSE;

        (* Modulate intake fans to achieve target adsorption face velocity *)
        IF bAirLouversOpenFeedback THEN
            rAirFanSpeedSP_pct := 85.0;
        ELSE
            rAirFanSpeedSP_pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Breakthrough detection logic: exhaust CO2 rises above 85% of ambient inlet CO2 *)
        bSorbentBreakthroughDetected := (rContactorExhaustCO2_ppm > (rAmbientCO2_ppm * 0.850)) AND (rStateElapsedSec > 180.0);

        (* Adsorption Duration Watchdog: 90 minutes max nominal duration *)
        tAdsorptionMaxTimer(IN := (iState = 10), PT := T#5400S);

        IF (bSorbentBreakthroughDetected OR tAdsorptionMaxTimer.Q OR (rCurrentSorbentLoading_q >= 2.10)) AND bAirLouversOpenFeedback THEN
            tAdsorptionMaxTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Transition to ADSORPTION_BREAKTHROUGH_ISOLATION *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 20: ADSORPTION_BREAKTHROUGH_ISOLATION
          Air fans stopped, hermetic intake and exhaust louvers commanded closed.
          Chamber isolation integrity verified prior to inertization.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        rAirFanSpeedSP_pct              := 0.0;
        bAirLouversCommandOpen          := FALSE;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 0.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 0.0;
        rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct         := 0.0;

        (* Dwell until louvers fully seal and air velocity dissipates *)
        IF bAirLouversClosedFeedback AND (rStateElapsedSec > 15.0) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Transition to N2_INERT_PURGE_BARRIER *)
        ELSIF rStateElapsedSec > 60.0 THEN
            (* Seal failure alarm *)
            dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000010; (* Alarm Bit 4: Louver seal failure *)
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    30: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 30: N2_INERT_PURGE_BARRIER (Flammability & Anti-Oxidation Boundary)
          Gaseous N2 injected to displace residual air and oxygen from monolith voids.
          Contactor must reach O2 < 0.20% before any steam injection is permitted.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        bAirLouversCommandOpen          := FALSE;
        rAirFanSpeedSP_pct              := 0.0;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 0.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 0.0;

        (* Modulate N2 purge valve to establish positive displacement sweeping *)
        rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct := 65.0;

        (* Flammability Barrier Verification: Debounced 10.0 s stabilization *)
        tPurgeSettleTimer(IN := bInertBarrierEstablished, PT := T#10.0S);

        IF tPurgeSettleTimer.Q AND (rStateElapsedSec > 25.0) THEN
            tPurgeSettleTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
            iState := 40; (* Transition to ROOTS_VACUUM_ROUGHING_EVACUATION *)
        ELSIF rStateElapsedSec > 300.0 THEN
            (* N2 Purge Timeout Alarm: Inability to displace oxygen indicates chamber leak *)
            dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000020; (* Alarm Bit 5: N2 Inert Purge Timeout *)
            rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    40: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 40: ROOTS_VACUUM_ROUGHING_EVACUATION
          Roughing dry screw pump starts, drawing contactor pressure down from 101.3 kPa to 50.0 kPa.
          Protects Roots rotary lobes from high aerodynamic drag and mechanical overload.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        bAirLouversCommandOpen          := FALSE;
        rAirFanSpeedSP_pct              := 0.0;
        rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct         := 0.0;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 0.0;

        (* Run roughing pump at 100% capacity *)
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct := 100.0;

        tRoughingEvacTimeout(IN := (iState = 40), PT := T#240.0S);

        IF (rVotedContactorPressure_kPa <= 50.0) AND (rStateElapsedSec > 10.0) THEN
            tRoughingEvacTimeout(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 50; (* Transition to ROOTS_BOOSTER_DEEP_EVACUATION *)
        ELSIF tRoughingEvacTimeout.Q THEN
            dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000040; (* Alarm Bit 6: Roughing vacuum timeout *)
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    50: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 50: ROOTS_BOOSTER_DEEP_EVACUATION
          Multi-stage Roots rotary booster blowers engage via soft VFD ramp.
          Chamber drawn down from 50.0 kPa to target desorption vacuum 20.0 kPa.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 100.0;
        rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct         := 0.0;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;

        (* Ramp Roots Booster VFD speed *)
        IF rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct < 85.0 THEN
            rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct := rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct + 2.5;
        END_IF;

        tBoosterDeepEvacTimeout(IN := (iState = 50), PT := T#180.0S);

        IF (rVotedContactorPressure_kPa <= (rTargetDesorptionPress_kPa + 1.50)) AND (rStateElapsedSec > 15.0) THEN
            tBoosterDeepEvacTimeout(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 60; (* Transition to STEAM_PURGE_WARMUP_INJECTION *)
        ELSIF tBoosterDeepEvacTimeout.Q THEN
            dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000080; (* Alarm Bit 7: Booster deep vacuum timeout *)
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    60: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 60: STEAM_PURGE_WARMUP_INJECTION (Sensible Heating & Trap Clearing)
          STRICT INTERLOCK: Oxygen MUST be < 0.20% prior to steam valve opening!
          Low-pressure steam admitted slowly (10-25%) to preheat piping and monolith structure.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        (* CRITICAL SAFETY INTERLOCK CHECK *)
        IF NOT bInertBarrierEstablished THEN
            dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000100; (* Alarm Bit 8: O2 breach during steam phase *)
            bSteamSafetyShutoffCommand := FALSE;
            rSteamControlValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
            iState := 999;
        ELSE
            bSteamSafetyShutoffCommand := TRUE; (* Open double-block-and-bleed steam shutoff *)
            rSteamControlValveDemand_pct := 25.0; (* Controlled warmup flow *)
            rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct := 60.0;
            rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct := 50.0;
            rEconomizerCoolingValveDemand_pct := 40.0;

            tSteamWarmupTimer(IN := (iState = 60), PT := T#60.0S);

            (* Advance when bed temperature reaches initial condensation threshold (> 65 deg C) *)
            IF (rVotedBedTemp_degC >= 65.0) OR tSteamWarmupTimer.Q THEN
                tSteamWarmupTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 70; (* Transition to VTSA_ACTIVE_DESORPTION_CO2_EXTRACTION *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    70: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 70: VTSA_ACTIVE_DESORPTION_CO2_EXTRACTION (100 deg C, 20 kPa)
          Full steam stripping desorption. Steam delivers sensible heat of reaction (68.5 kJ/mol)
          and acts as sweep gas to shift desorption equilibrium. Roots blowers evacuate CO2/steam.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        IF NOT bInertBarrierEstablished THEN
            bSteamSafetyShutoffCommand := FALSE;
            rSteamControlValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
            dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000100;
            iState := 999;
        ELSE
            bDesorptionActive := TRUE;
            bSteamSafetyShutoffCommand := TRUE;

            (* Actuator commands assigned from MPC or Fallback PID in Module 4 *)
            rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := vecInput_u[1];
            rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := vecInput_u[2];
            rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 100.0;
            rEconomizerCoolingValveDemand_pct:= vecInput_u[5];

            (* Desorption duration and completion conditions *)
            tDesorptionActiveTimer(IN := (iState = 70), PT := T#1200.0S); (* 20 minutes nominal *)

            (* Sorbent desorption complete when residual loading drops to <= 0.22 mol/kg or timer expires *)
            bDesorptionComplete := (rCurrentSorbentLoading_q <= 0.220) AND (rStateElapsedSec > 180.0);

            IF (bDesorptionComplete OR tDesorptionActiveTimer.Q) AND (rStateElapsedSec > 300.0) THEN
                tDesorptionActiveTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 80; (* Transition to CONDENSATE_LATENT_HEAT_RECOVERY *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    80: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 80: CONDENSATE_LATENT_HEAT_RECOVERY & BALANCING
          Steam injection modulated down; economizer flash tank completes liquid separation.
          Stabilizes boiler feedwater return mass balance.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 10.0;
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 100.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 70.0;
        rEconomizerCoolingValveDemand_pct:= 90.0;
        bDesorptionActive               := TRUE;

        IF (rStateElapsedSec > 45.0) AND (ABS(rCondensateMassImbalance_kgh) < 25.0) THEN
            iState := 90; (* Transition to STEAM_CUTOFF_DECOMPRESSION_PURGE *)
        ELSIF rStateElapsedSec > 120.0 THEN
            iState := 90;
        END_IF;

    90: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 90: STEAM_CUTOFF_DECOMPRESSION_PURGE (Vacuum Scavenge)
          Steam isolation valve closed and locked. Deep vacuum scavenge (10-15 kPa) sweeps residual
          moisture and liberated CO2 out of the contactor voids to prevent condensation pooling.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        bSteamSafetyShutoffCommand      := FALSE;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        bDesorptionActive               := FALSE;
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 100.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 95.0; (* Maximum speed deep scavenge *)

        tVacuumScavengeTimer(IN := (iState = 90), PT := T#90.0S);

        IF tVacuumScavengeTimer.Q OR (rVotedContactorPressure_kPa <= 12.0) THEN
            tVacuumScavengeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 100; (* Transition to MONOLITH_REGENERATIVE_COOLING *)
        END_IF;

    100:(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 100: MONOLITH_REGENERATIVE_COOLING
          Roots booster blowers throttled down. Contactor honeycomb cooled to T < 45 deg C.
          CRITICAL: Sorbent MUST NOT be exposed to ambient air while temperature is > 45 deg C!
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        bSteamSafetyShutoffCommand      := FALSE;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 30.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 0.0;

        (* Controlled cool-down duration *)
        tCoolingDwellTimer(IN := (iState = 100), PT := T#300.0S);

        bBedCoolingComplete := (rVotedBedTemp_degC <= 45.0);

        IF bBedCoolingComplete OR tCoolingDwellTimer.Q THEN
            tCoolingDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 110; (* Transition to VACUUM_BREAK_REPRESSURIZATION *)
        END_IF;

    110:(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 110: VACUUM_BREAK_REPRESSURIZATION
          Controlled, filtered repressurization from 15 kPa vacuum back to 101.3 kPa atmospheric.
          Slow repressurization rate (< 5 kPa/s) protects thin honeycomb walls from acoustic shock.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 0.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 0.0;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;

        (* Modulate N2 or filtered air vacuum break valve *)
        rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct         := 40.0;

        tRepressurizationTimer(IN := (iState = 110), PT := T#120.0S);

        bChamberRepressurized := (rVotedContactorPressure_kPa >= (rAmbientPressure_kPa - 2.0));

        IF bChamberRepressurized OR tRepressurizationTimer.Q THEN
            tRepressurizationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
            iState := 120; (* Transition to CYCLE_COMPLETE_READY *)
        END_IF;

    120:(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 120: CYCLE_COMPLETE_READY (Metrics Accumulation & Auto-Reloop)
          Updates cycle counters, calculates thermal energy efficiency, logs performance metrics.
          Automatically reloops to AMBIENT_AIR_ADSORPTION if master enable remains TRUE.
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        rAirFanSpeedSP_pct              := 0.0;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 0.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 0.0;
        rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct         := 0.0;
        bAirLouversCommandOpen          := FALSE;

        (* Performance Metrics Logging *)
        diTotalCyclesCompleted := diTotalCyclesCompleted + 1;
        rWorkingCapacity_molkg := rMaxSorbentCapacity_molkg - rCurrentSorbentLoading_q;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;

        IF bEnableSystem AND (NOT bEStopLatched) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Continuous cyclic operation: restart adsorption *)
        ELSE
            iState := 0;  (* Standby *)
        END_IF;

    999:(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          PHASE 999: EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_SAFE_PARK (SIL-3 Fail-Safe De-energized State)
          Hardwired shutdown state:
            - Steam safety isolation double-block valves slammed shut
            - Vacuum pumps and Roots blowers tripped immediately
            - Main ambient air intake fans tripped and louvers commanded closed
            - N2 inert blanketing applied to prevent any air ingress onto hot sorbent
            - Alarms latched until manual operator inspection and reset
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        bSteamSafetyShutoffCommand      := FALSE;
        rSteamControlValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rAirFanSpeedSP_pct              := 0.0;
        rRootsRoughingPumpCmd_pct       := 0.0;
        rRootsBoosterVFD_SpeedSP_pct    := 0.0;
        bAirLouversCommandOpen          := FALSE;
        bDesorptionActive               := FALSE;
        bSystemReady                    := FALSE;

        (* Emergency inert blanket: inject N2 if chamber is under vacuum or hot *)
        IF (rVotedContactorPressure_kPa < 90.0) OR (rVotedBedTemp_degC > 50.0) THEN
            rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct := 50.0;
        ELSE
            rN2PurgeValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Remain locked in state 999 until explicit fault reset *)

    ELSE
        (* Illegal State Recovery: Unconditionally divert to fail-safe state *)
        iState := 999;

END_CASE;
(*
====================================================================================================
  MODULE 6: ACTUATOR ASSIGNMENT, OUTPUT MAPPING & ISA-18.2 DIAGNOSTICS BITFIELDS
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Construct 32-bit Operational Status Word (dwSystemStatusWord) *)
dwSystemStatusWord := 16#00000000;
IF bSystemReady                 THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000001; END_IF;
IF bInertBarrierEstablished     THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000002; END_IF;
IF bDesorptionActive            THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000004; END_IF;
IF bCO2PurityCompliant          THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000008; END_IF;
IF bAutoMPC_Mode                THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000010; END_IF;
IF bAirLouversClosedFeedback    THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000020; END_IF;
IF bAirLouversOpenFeedback      THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000040; END_IF;
IF bSteamBlockValveOpenFeedback THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000080; END_IF;
IF bDegradedSensorMode          THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000100; END_IF;
IF bEStopLatched                THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#00000200; END_IF;

(* Pack current state machine phase into upper nibbles [bits 16..23] *)
rTempCalc := INT_TO_REAL(iState);
dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR SHL(INT_TO_DWORD(iState), 16);

(* Check Process Warnings (dwWarningWord) *)
IF rRootsCompressionRatio > 2.50 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000040; (* Warning Bit 6: High Roots compression ratio *)
END_IF;
IF rVotedBedTemp_degC > 105.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000080; (* Warning Bit 7: Sorbent Bed High Temp Warning *)
END_IF;
IF rEconomizerFlashLevel_pct > 85.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000100; (* Warning Bit 8: Flash Tank High Level *)
END_IF;
IF rEconomizerFlashLevel_pct < 15.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000200; (* Warning Bit 9: Flash Tank Low Level *)
END_IF;

(* Check Critical Alarms (dwActiveAlarmsWord) *)
IF NOT bSafetyRelayOK THEN
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000200; (* Alarm Bit 9: Safety Relay Chain Broken *)
END_IF;
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000400; (* Alarm Bit 10: E-Stop Button Actuated *)
END_IF;
IF (rVotedBedTemp_degC > 115.0) THEN
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00000800; (* Alarm Bit 11: Bed Over-Temperature Trip *)
    iState := 999;
END_IF;
IF (rVotedContactorPressure_kPa > 115.0) THEN
    dwActiveAlarmsWord := dwActiveAlarmsWord OR 16#00001000; (* Alarm Bit 12: Chamber Over-Pressure Trip *)
    iState := 999;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
